name: Tower of Ipsissimus
description:
When played: Deal 1 Piercing DMG to all your characters.
When Adventure Experience reaches an even number of times: Generate 1 random basic Elemental Die.
When Adventure Experience reaches 5: Create a Wooden Toy Sword and add it to your Hand.
When Adventure Experience reaches 12: Create a Reforge the Holy Blade and add it to your Hand. Then, discard this card.
